[95;1mMew[39;22m is a Go-based JavaScript toolchain and package manager for packages, scripts, and runtime enhancements. [2m(v0.0.0-test+deadbee)[22m

Usage: [95;1mm[39;22m <command> [...flags] [...args]

Common workflows
  install:        Install dependencies [2m(m i)[22m
  add:            Add a dependency [2m(m a)[22m
  run:            Run a package script
  x:              Execute a package binary [2m(m mx)[22m
  exec:           Execute a local package binary
  ci:             Clean install from lockfile
  update:         Update dependencies and refresh the lockfile

Dependencies and packages
  init:           Initialize a project
  remove:         Remove a dependency [2m(m rm)[22m
  link:           Link a local package
  dedupe:         Reduce duplicate dependencies in the lockfile
  prune:          Remove extraneous packages from node_modules
  resolve:        Resolve dependencies without installing
  fetch:          Download and extract packages from a fetch plan
  lock:           Lockfile utilities
  patch:          Extract a dependency for patching or commit a patch
  publish:        Publish a package
  pkg:            Read package.json fields
  project:        Inspect the current project

Run and scripts
  env:            Inspect execution environments
  view:           View package metadata from the registry
  watch:          Watch files and restart on changes

Inspect and recover
  ls:             List dependency tree or workspace packages [2m(m list)[22m
  outdated:       Check for outdated package versions
  explain:        Explain resolution decisions [2m(m why)[22m
  plan:           Preview install mutations
  history:        Show install snapshot timeline
  snapshot:       Manage install snapshots
  doctor:         Check project and package-manager health
  features:       List capability inventory and parity status
  diff:           Diff project artifacts
  recover:        Recover from an interrupted install transaction
  rollback:       Restore the previous install snapshot

Security and trust
  audit:          Audit dependencies for known vulnerabilities
  policy:         Evaluate organizational supply-chain policy
  verify:         Verify package attestations
  sbom:           Export a software bill of materials
  builds:         Lifecycle build script audit
  trust:          Trust lifecycle scripts for packages
  approve-builds: Approve lifecycle scripts for packages [2m(m approve-build)[22m

Cache and artifacts
  cache:          Manage the download cache
  store:          Manage the content store
  pack:           Create a package tarball
  capsule:        Create and restore portable dependency capsules

Configuration and tooling
  config:         Manage configuration
  development:    Developer tooling
  benchmark:      Performance benchmarks [2m(m bench)[22m
  conformance:    Run certification conformance suites
  version:        Print version information
  completion:     Generate shell completion scripts

Other
  node-args:      Run a JS file with explicit Node/V8 flags
  resolve-module: Show how [95;1mMew[39;22m resolves a module specifier
  runtime:        Inspect and trace runtime execution
  transform:      Inspect transform capabilities and compiler option support

Flags:
      --accessible           accessible append-only output
      --ascii                use ASCII instead of Unicode symbols
      --config string        JSONC config file overlay path
      --cwd string           project working directory
      --debug                verbose diagnostics [2m(env MEW_DEBUG or M_LOG=debug)[22m
      --filter stringArray   workspace package filter [2m(pnpm-style)[22m
  -h, --help                 help for [95;1mMew[39;22m
      --log-level string     log level: error [2m|[22m warn [2m|[22m info [2m|[22m debug
      --no-color             disable ANSI color
      --no-progress          disable progress output
      --no-summary           suppress command summary output
      --offline              force offline mode
      --output string        output mode: rich [2m|[22m plain [2m|[22m json [2m|[22m ndjson [2m|[22m silent
      --prefer-offline       prefer cached artifacts
  -r, --recursive            workspace recursive mode [2m(consumed by m run)[22m
  -v, --version              version for [95;1mMew[39;22m

Use "[95;1mm[39;22m [command] --help" for more information about a command.
Use "[95;1mm[39;22m help <topic>" for curated topics [2m(errors, runner, lifecycle-trust, …)[22m.
